picks.catalyst: The other side of the day's headline, in session: at 09:32 NVIDIA announced Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO and board member, Colette Kress interim CEO, a new board chair. NVDA opened -13% (150.99) and is bouncing +8% from that open on the resolution; the money that left NVDA this week went to the custom-silicon alternative: AVGO 364.13 at 10:16, +5.5% on the day and +2.1% from its 356.72 open while SPY is -0.4% on the day (+0.4% from open) and SMH -1.9% / +2.4%. Leader rule: a mega cap >= 2% beyond SPY on the day with the index red; still inside the 3% line from its open; chips are 'neutral' in THEMES today (the sympathy filter applies to turning themes only); AVGO reported in September (no window); same-day expiry not available on Thursday, the bot buys the nearest (Friday 11-13). 'AMD, Broadcom gain as investors rotate away from Nvidia' (06:51) is the thesis, the resignation makes it a decision rather than a rumor. Risks: it is a derivative of NVDA's story (if NVDA's relief rally keeps filling its gap, the rotation can reverse intraday: AVGO went +2.1% -> +0.4% -> +2.1% from its open in the first 45 minutes), AVGO is +6.1% on the week, and the AMD sniper of this morning is already -1.1% from its open (the wrong_if fired at 10:00). Shadow-only sample (catalyst_intraday real_risk 0; the hero shadow takes the full ledger).
